agent_instructions.role: You are a Principal Mobile Architect specializing in Islamic and high-precision sensor-based Android applications. Your goal is to write highly performance-optimized, clean, and beautifully localized code for 'Al-Mumin Enterprise' following strict MVVM + Clean Architecture principles.
code_standards: Zero-clutter architecture: separation of concerns between raw UI presentation, reactive ViewModel state-holders, domain business logic, and transactional repositories.
Strict memory footprint management for audio and storage systems.
Beautiful custom canvas rendering for traditional Islamic borders, dials, and vector graphics.
Robust offline-first architecture with localized room state caches.

dependencies.networking: com.squareup.retrofit2:retrofit:2.9.0 (for fetching audio streams and on-demand files)
dependencies.media: androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer:1.3.1 (for highly reliable audio streaming and caching)

onboarding_flow.description: A clean, dual-step localized startup wizard setting up country-specific and language-specific configs before accessing the main dashboard.
requirements: Step 1: Language Selector. User selects preferred interface language (Arabic, French, English, Spanish). The app instantly updates the configuration context globally.

Step 2: Country Selector. User selects country (highlighting Morocco as featured). If Morocco is selected, automatically lock calculation method to 'CalculationMethod.MOROCCO' (Moroccan Ministry of Habous and Islamic Affairs method: Fajr at 19 degrees, Isha at 17 degrees, adjustments: -3 min Sunrise, +5 min Dhuhr, +5 min Maghrib).
Save the selected onboarding configuration inside Datastore Preferences so this screen only runs on the first launch.

salat_times_and_location.description: High-accuracy dual-provider prayer calculation framework engineered for reliable local timings using dual network/GPS location queries.
requirements: Dual location fallback: Use Google FusedLocationProviderClient to query both GPS (Fine) and Wi-Fi/Cell towers (Coarse) networks simultaneously. If hardware GPS is missing or shielded indoors, seamlessly fall back to network/Wi-Fi-based coordinates.

Completely local calculations via Batoulapps Adhan library. Cache last successful coordinates in DataStore/SharedPreferences. If offline with no signal, utilize cached coordinates immediately to generate correct astronomical schedules.
Pre-register Calculation Method configurations based on onboarding country (e.g., Ministry of Habous for Morocco, Egyptian Authority for North Africa, Umm Al-Qura for KSA, MWL for general).

adhan_audio_notifications.description: Enterprise-grade foreground scheduler playing custom local audio alarms precisely at prayer times, offering the top 5 historic and popular global voices.
requirements: Create an AlarmManager wrapper registering Exact Alarms (utilizing 'setAlarmClock' for maximum device wake-up reliability).
Include options in Settings to choose from the following 5 Adhan voices:
1. Makkah (Al-Haram - Sheikh Ali Mulla)
2. Madinah (Al-Nabawi - Sheikh Surayhi)
3. Al-Aqsa (Jerusalem)
4. Morocco (Maghiri / Andalusian traditional style)
5. Sheikh Abdul Basit Abdus Samad
Ship lightweight default audio files in the 'res/raw' folder or handle a robust internal downloader to stream/cache these high-quality audio formats safely.

qibla_compass.description: High-fidelity compass direction visualizer using device orientation sensors with extreme noise isolation.
requirements: Listen to 'Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR' dynamically. Fall back gracefully to 'Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER' + 'Sensor.TYPE_MAGNETIC_FIELD' on legacy hardware.
Implement a Low-Pass Noise Filter (exponential moving average: angle = alpha * newAngle + (1 - alpha) * oldAngle) to prevent any needle jittering, assuring premium smooth rendering.

Calculate Qibla bearing relative to current GPS/Wi-Fi coordinates and Kaaba location using Great Circle Formula: theta = atan2(sin(dLON)*cos(LAT2), cos(LAT1)*sin(LAT2) - sin(LAT1)*cos(LAT2)*cos(dLON)).

Design a rich canvas dial representing North and a distinct green-gold Arrow pointing directly to the Kaaba. Provide brief haptic vibration pulse via 'Vibrator' utility when matching perfectly (angle diff < 1.5°).

quran_reader_paginated.description: Arabic-only high-design visual Quran reader mimicking the beautiful, standard 15-line Madinah Mushaf (resembling 'standard2-quran.pdf') layout.
requirements: No distracting default translations on screen. Maintain an immersive, purely Arabic visual focus using authentic vector-based or beautiful Amiri/Scheherazade Quranic fonts.
Implement page-by-page swiping (using HorizontalPager or customized Canvas layouts) replicating the 604-page structure of the classic Mushaf.
Introduce visual UI styling controls: Dynamic Arabic font-size slider, high-contrast reading themes (Cream, Soft Warm Gold, Dark Night Mode), and traditional elegant framing surrounding page borders.

quran_audio_caching.description: On-demand progressive audio downloader for specific Surahs to maintain minimal physical storage footprint on user phones.
requirements: Supported Reciters API URLs (use Quran.com audio/MP3 cdn structure or secure audio links):
1. Saad Al-Ghamdi (Said Lahandy)
2. Saud Al-Shuraim
3. Maher Al-Muaiqly
4. Ali Jaber
Implement a download-on-demand service: When a user clicks play for a Surah, the app streams directly from API and initiates a background download in the device's internal cache folder.
Automatically save files with name structures like 'reciterId_surahNum.mp3'. Maintain a database of downloaded files so the user can play them completely offline later.
Provide a clear storage dashboard in settings displaying total cache size and a button to clean files to optimize storage.

adhkar_and_hadith.description: A dedicated spiritual companion screen providing morning/evening Adhkar and daily curated authentic advices.
requirements: Morning Supplications (Adkar Al-Sabah) and Evening Supplications (Adkar Al-Masaa) displaying the supplication text, reference, counter button (tapping decreases required loop, with slight haptic feedback on completion).
Daily Hadith and Muslim Advice section displaying authentic Hadith with simple custom sharing options (WhatsApp, SMS, copying text).

theme_color_palette.dark_background: #0D1310 (Ultra Dark Forest Black for low-light comfort)

execution_steps.step_1_onboarding_and_localization: Build the first-launch localization setup screens. Create custom country/language selections, configure local system locale switches, and map calculation models directly.

execution_steps.step_2_location_provider: Implement the FusedLocationProviderClient utility class. Setup the permission-handler mechanism. Ensure fallback from fine-GPS coordinates to Wi-Fi/Cell network coordinates, caching coordinates locally.

execution_steps.step_3_adhan_and_scheduler: Wire up the Batoulapps Adhan library under the local calculations repository, mapping 'Morocco Ministry of Habous' dynamically. Code the background AlarmManager framework to broadcast and play the selected top 5 Adhan files on exact schedules.

execution_steps.step_4_qibla_sensor_canvas: Develop the custom sensor interface using SensorManager. Apply the low-pass filter formula to orientation sensors. Draw the high-fidelity Compose Custom Canvas pointer showing true North vs Kaaba direction.

execution_steps.step_5_quran_page_rendering: Design the Arabic-only Quran reader layout modeled after physical 15-line layouts. Embed custom Islamic fonts. Incorporate progressive streaming/downloading via ExoPlayer for the requested reciters (Saad Al-Ghamdi, Al-Shuraim, Al-Muaiqly, Ali Jaber) caching MP3 files onto persistent memory.

execution_steps.step_6_adhkar_and_hadith: Add local storage tables or hardcoded localized structures for morning/evening Adhkar (with digital counter taps) and daily Hadiths.
